messages:
maria: Quick sync on announcement choreography for H100 / MI300 / Gaudi across marketplace + SI demos. Need a non-overlap plan by EOD.

sam: I'll own marketplace capacity and GA windows. Will list region caps and slot suggestions.

lee: SI side: partners want demo exclusives. Recommend we reserve 1-2 exclusives/vendor and publish a fallback matrix.

vivian: Comms ask: block any two public vendor posts within 36h for APAC. US/EU can be warnings only.

ops-bot: New doc created: /docs/partners/announce-orchestration-v0. Reviewers: sam, vivian.

maria: Can someone draft a tiny matrix: region | preferred | fallback | press-risk? Keep it 4 rows.

sam: Draft: us-east | h100 | h200 | med; eu-west | mi300 | h200 | low; apac | h100 | mi300 | high; sa | gaudi | mi300 | med. I'll attach quotas.

lee: Note: gaudi firmware sign-off scheduled next Tue in EU - risk of 3-5 day slip. Mark as firmware-risk.

vivian: I'll prepare embargo playbook + exception workflow. Want final matrix before PR.

maria: Action items: sam update quotas (tomorrow), lee collect SI exclusives (EOD), vivian PR embargo playbook (EOD). Recheck Thu morning.

ops-bot: Task created: /tasks/40021 - "gaudi firmware sign-off watch" assigned to hw-ops.

maria: Thanks team. If any slip >48h call immediate sync.
